reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to automate academic talk creation from papers, with explicit workflow steps (paper retrieval, venue-aware planning, and slide assembly) that coordinate other services, so it is classified as orchestration rather than pure content generation or UI tooling.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中将论文转为学术汇报稿：输入论文标识和汇报场景后，按场景规划时长与结构，并驱动生成幻灯片与演讲稿式讲稿内容。
summaries.en: This plugin helps DeepSeek Harness users turn a paper into a planned academic talk by using paper retrieval, venue-aware timing rules, and slide generation steps to produce slide content with speaker-note scripts.

capabilities: Coordinates a paper-to-talk workflow by invoking planning and generation steps across other plugins
Provides venue- and duration-based planning for slide structure and content allocation
Delegates deck rendering to the slide output plugin for HTML/PPTX delivery formats

reasons.code: README describes the tool chain as: read paper by DOI/title, budget the talk, then build slides, with explicit venue slot rules.
README states this plugin is "the arc between" dsh-ai4scholar and dsh-slides, making it an orchestration layer rather than a standalone renderer.
Package metadata exposes a DSH bundle patch and declares plugin entry points and peer dependencies for DSH ecosystem integration.
